# North Peptides UK

> UK-stocked research peptides and reference compounds, supplied strictly for laboratory and scientific research use only — not for human or animal consumption. Selected compounds are independently HPLC-tested with certificates published on-site. Orders dispatch within 24–48h of confirmed payment via tracked UK delivery.
